newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian BNDT 10 bln yen 20-yr eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian BNDT 10 bln yen 20-yr eurobond.

text.p: Tunisian Banque Nationale de Developpement Touristique has launched a 10-billion yen 20-year eurobond, bankers said on Friday.
The issue, with a coupon of 4.75 percent, matures in June 2017. It was arranged by Goldman Sachs International and is guaranteed by the Tunisian state.
Bankers said it was the first time a Tunisian borrower had issued a 20-year maturity. The most recent issue by the Tunisian state was a 15-year samurai bond last year with a coupon of 4.95 percent.

BNDT is a state-controlled development bank specialising in loans to the tourism sector. It has so far invested a total of 850 million dinars ($790 million) in the booming tourism sector whose revenues totalled $1.4 billion last year.
The deal was signed on Thursday in Tunis by BNDT's chairman Said Mrabet.
